requirements.commute_tolerance_note: Lane may eventually tolerate roughly an hour if the neighborhood is worth it.
requirements.term: 6-12 month rental. Year-one housing is infrastructure, not a forever-home decision.

analysis_rule: Do not infer safety from aesthetics. Score objective/current crime context, street and traffic context, nuisance factors, parking, dog practicality and commute separately from subjective vibe. A 'what would experienced longtime LA friends flag here?' lens is a hypothetical reality check only - never attribute it as a real person's opinion.
